title: Parenting
learning_outcomes: Explain child development in the context of parenting.
Compare and distinguish responsive care in the context of parenting.
Apply nonviolent boundaries in the context of parenting.
Evaluate and justify decisions about safeguarding in the context of parenting.

lessons.title: Child development
lessons.outcome: Explain child development in the context of parenting.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving child development; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to fictional caregiving plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain child development from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of child development; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Responsive care
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish responsive care in the context of parenting.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving responsive care; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to fictional caregiving plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain responsive care from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of responsive care; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Nonviolent boundaries
lessons.outcome: Apply nonviolent boundaries in the context of parenting.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving nonviolent boundaries; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to fictional caregiving plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain nonviolent boundaries from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of nonviolent boundaries; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Safeguarding
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about safeguarding in the context of parenting.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving safeguarding; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to fictional caregiving plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain safeguarding from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of safeguarding; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of child development; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of responsive care; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of nonviolent boundaries; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of safeguarding; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
